gloss: under renovation; being remodeled; closed for refurbishment

definitions.gloss: under renovation; being remodeled; closed for refurbishment
definitions.explanation: a state where a building, store, or facility is currently being renovated or remodeled

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{改装中|かいそうちゅう}です。
{改装中|かいそうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will be temporarily closed for renovation.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{気|き}に{入|い}り→お気に入り：10297_okiniiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{改装中|かいそうちゅう}で、リニューアル⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My favorite restaurant is under renovation, and I'm looking forward to its reopening.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧ (renovation/remodeling) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during/in the middle of). A very common sign and announcement seen on storefronts and buildings in Japan. The suffix ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ is productive and attaches to many nouns to indicate an ongoing activity (⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧, ⟦{準備中|じゅんびちゅう}→準備中：09540_junbichuu⟧, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改装中|かいそうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧: closed for renovation
- {改装中|かいそうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧: store under renovation
- {只今|ただいま}{改装中|かいそうちゅう}: currently under renovation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧: under construction — for building or infrastructure work, not just interior remodeling
- ⟦{準備中|じゅんびちゅう}→準備中：09540_junbichuu⟧: in preparation — used when a shop is getting ready to open for the day
- {休業中|きゅうぎょうちゅう}: temporarily closed — closed for any reason, not necessarily renovation
